comicStrip.heading: From isolated programmes to a connected data space

frames.alt: Theatre clerk on the phone – speech bubble “Yes, I have time.”
frames.title: Ready for the data space
frames.caption: Theatres get an open interface and decide themselves what to share.

frames.alt: Theatre clerk at the desk – thought bubble “Everyone knows.”
frames.title: Programmes become readable
frames.caption: A standardised JSON interface makes every event machine-readable.

frames.alt: Theatre clerk on the phone – speech bubble “I have endless connections.”
frames.title: Endless connections
frames.caption: Through the Cultural Data Space data flows to platforms, archives and services – without copy & paste.

pitch.heading: We lay the pipeline – you keep control
body: This project is commissioned by the Deutscher Bühnenverein as Use Case 3 of the Cultural Data Space and is part of Germany's digital strategy.
Theatres get a standardised interface for their programmes – and remain the owners of their data.
